profile.summary: A private university in La Verne, California. It offers undergraduate and graduate degrees through several colleges, including Arts and Sciences, Business and Public Management, Education, Law, and Health and Community Well-Being. It also runs regional campuses in the greater Los Angeles area and Kern County.
